Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing property assessments and the appeal of those assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to property assessments and the appeal of thoseassessments; and adding a new section to chapter 36.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each assessment sent to a property owner for real estate taxpurposes must be signed by the assessor who is accountable for thevaluation amount and must include their contact information and theprocess for appealing the assessment valuation amount. (2) For appraisals with a value over five hundred thousand dollars,the appraisal must be signed by an accredited appraiser.
